deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing words ('the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus') into a specific anatomical description ('The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus') that the lecturer did not give and that the text does not show to be correct.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The rewrite inserts 'therefore', asserting a causal link that the tumour is circumscribed as a result of the fixation and staining process, whereas the lecturer only noted that the physical separation allows one to see ('So you can see again that...') that it is separate.

considerations.reason: The rewrite changes 'circumspect' to 'circumscribed'. Although 'circumspect' was not listed in the term corrections, it is an obvious transcription error for the medical term 'circumscribed', and correcting it does not harm student learning.
